Brush hauling

How we do it.

Sometimes the trees are fine and the problem is the pile: limbs that came down in the last storm, brush from a weekend of clearing, or debris left behind by someone else's job. We load it up and take it away.

Small limbs go through the chipper on site. Logs and big wood go on the truck. You get your yard back the same day.

We do this work in Portland, Taft, Gregory, Sinton, Odem, Calallen, Ingleside, Aransas Pass, Woodsboro, plus Refugio. Free estimates everywhere we go.

  • Brush pilesLoaded up and gone in one visit.
  • Storm debrisFallen limbs cut to size and hauled off.
  • Chipped on siteSmall limbs fed into the chipper so nothing is left at the curb.
  • Logs and big woodCut to size and loaded on the truck.

Questions

Answers before you call.

Do you haul brush you didn't cut?

Yes. If it's tree debris, we'll haul it, whoever cut it.

Can you come the same week?

Usually. Call or text a photo of the pile and we'll give you a price and a day.

Do you pick up brush from a storm?

Yes. Fallen limbs and storm debris are cut to size, chipped or loaded, and hauled away.

Can I just get a pile hauled off without other work?

Yes. Text a photo of the pile to (361) 548-4857 and we'll give you a price.

Do you haul logs and big wood?

Yes. Logs and big wood go on the truck. Small limbs go through the chipper on site.

Is there a minimum size job?

Call or text with what you have and we'll tell you honestly whether it makes sense for us to come out.
